brief.scope: Work order: the uncited-correction gate. The requirements are the ten numbered Contract items of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md, tracked in this snapshot at the ref; read it and .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-discipline.md WHOLE from the snapshot tree. Nothing else is a requirement. Refuse at mint any write job that answers reviewer findings unless every finding it answers is named by key, disposed in the findings ledger, and the disposition cites the numbered contract item it violates; the ladder stops before its fix stages instead of correcting. No override. Boundaries as listed there; do not widen them.

findings.claim: Contract items 1, 2 and 3: item 1 reads the correction shape from the dispatch arguments (a write job whose --input is a file from a review record's out/). _input_record_id classifies via Path.resolve(), so the shape is taken from the symlink target, not the --input argument. A write job with --input lexically under a review job's out/ that is a symlink leaving jobs_root returns {"correction": false, "answers": []} and launch.py mints that record; item 2 (a correction that names no key is refused) and item 3 (no record minted) do not fire. The inverse also fails item 1 and item 7: a write that follows nothing, whose --input argument is outside out/, is inspected and refused as a correction when the path resolves into a review out/.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('ops/conductor/tools/correction.py').resolve()
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('c', p)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    t = Path(td); records = t/'records'; jobs = t/'jobs'; records.mkdir()
    rid = '20260901T000000Z-review-grok-aaaaaa'
    (records/f'{rid}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'id': rid, 'job': 'adversarial-review'}))
    regular = jobs/rid/'out'/'note.md'; regular.parent.mkdir(parents=True); regular.write_text('artifact')
    outside = t/'outside'; outside.write_text('outside')
    out_link = jobs/rid/'out'/'review.md'; out_link.symlink_to(outside)
    inbound = t/'copied.md'; inbound.symlink_to(regular)
    at = '2026-09-11T00:00:00Z'
    def run(path):
        try:
            return ('ok', m.check('write', [], [str(path)], [], at, records, jobs, Path.cwd()))
        except m.Refused as e:
            return ('refused', e.kind)
    control, escaped, inbound_r = run(regular), run(out_link), run(inbound)
    print(control); print(escaped); print(inbound_r)
    assert control == ('refused', 'correction'), control
    assert escaped == ('ok', {'correction': False, 'answers': []}), escaped
    assert inbound_r == ('refused', 'correction'), inbound_r
PY
